findings.issue: 輸入 in 輸入しています is the verbal-noun component of a suru-compound, not an object; the sentence's object is 石油を, already labeled 'objeto'. Labeling 輸入 'objeto verbal' makes the learner see two objects. The corpus's own term elsewhere (e.g. 安心 in sent:gen-287f6395f696) is 'substantivo verbal'.
ごめん is an interjection meaning 'sorry' in this context; the noun gloss 'apology' does not match the token's use and does not parallel the pt gloss 'desculpa'.
